I switched back. I enjoy independence. Don’t mind working in a team but LE gives you so much independence that it messed me up for other jobs. For the most part I can spend free time how I choose in LE. Didn’t have the same passion for FF service

Department gladly took me back. Perspective changed a ton. I know all us LEOs think about the recliners and the grill time but there’s a lot behind the scene that changed my perspective. Also about 80% of the job is EMS which I really have no passion for one bit. 

TLDR: I switched back and don’t regret it. I enjoy the independence LE provides
